name: Stripe API create refund
description: Refund-creation operation family of the Stripe API. Moves money; card refunds can be cancelled only briefly and only from the Dashboard.

provenance.notes: Supports POST /v1/refunds; a fully refunded charge cannot be refunded again.
All v1 POST requests accept Idempotency-Key (up to 255 chars, prunable after 24 hours); parameter mismatch on reuse errors.

auth_methods api_key: restricted API keys (rk_) recommended; agent-tagged restricted keys are subject to approval rules covering refunds and payouts. required_scopes omitted: restricted-key permission names were not fetched.
